lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Good evening. Welcome. Do you have a reservation?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Yes, for two at seven under Rodriguez.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Please follow me to your table. Would you like something to drink?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Could we have water while we look at the menu?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: Certainly. Are you ready to order?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: Almost. Could you explain the vegetarian option?

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: It is roasted vegetables with rice and a side salad.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: That sounds good. We'll have two, please.

lines.speaker: server
lines.text: I'll send your order to the kitchen now.
